mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 5% YoY signals inflationary pressures that typically lead to tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 5% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000, it signals a tight labor market and strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) coupled with a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a contraction in demand and tighter monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST declines and FEDFUNDS rises and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases for 2 consecutive quarters and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.
